message:
The other night, we had a little power outage in our neighborhood. I’ll admit, I usually find myself scrambling when the lights go out, but this time I felt ready! I had my trusty flashlight handy, the lantern charged up, and even a power bank to keep my phone alive for a few extra hours. 

As I settled in for a cozy evening by lantern light, I couldn't help but chuckle at how nice it felt to finally be the prepared one for once. It was a little adventure that reminded me how simple things can keep us comfortable. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a blackout? 😊
